parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 所在地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The tag key of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 弹性网卡的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

If you use a single tag to filter resources, the resource count with the specified tag cannot exceed 1,000. If you use multiple tags to filter resources, the resource count of resources that are attached to all specified tags cannot exceed 1,000. If the resource count exceeds 1,000, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html operation to query the resources
fields.help_zh:
弹性网卡的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20

使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个。如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/110425.html接口进行查询
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID. If you use this parameter to filter resources, the resource count cannot exceed 1,000.

Filtering by the default resource group is not supported
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。使用该参数过滤资源时，资源数量不能超过1000个。

不支持默认资源组过滤
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID of the network interface controller (NIC)
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡所属的交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID of the network interface controller (NIC)
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡所属的专有网络VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The primary private IP address of the network interface controller (NIC)
parameters.name: primary_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The security group ID of the secondary ENI.

To query information about a secondary ENI by security group ID, specify this parameter.
To query information about a primary ENI by security group ID, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25506.html and specify the `SecurityGroupId` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
辅助网卡对应的安全组ID。

如果您需要通过安全组ID查询辅助网卡的信息，请指定该参数。
如果您需要通过安全组ID查询主网卡信息，请调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25506.html指定0参数进行查询
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the network interface controller (NIC). The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters from the Unicode letter categorization (which includes English letters, Chinese characters, and digits). The name can contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡的名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: network_interface_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Elastic Network Interface (ENI). Valid values:

Primary: primary network interface controller (NIC).
Secondary: secondary ENI.

Default value: null, which indicates that all types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
弹性网卡类型。取值范围：

Primary：主网卡。
Secondary：辅助网卡。

默认值：空，表示查询所有类型
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance to which the network interface controller (NIC) is attached
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡当前附加的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether the user of the network interface controller (NIC) is an Alibaba Cloud service or a Virtual Network Operator (VNO)
parameters.help_zh: 该弹性网卡的使用者是否为云产品或虚商
parameters.name: service_managed

parameters.help_en:
The status of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values:

Available: available.
Attaching: being attached.
InUse: attached.
Detaching: being detached.
Deleting: being deleted.

Default value: null, which indicates that all statuses are queried
parameters.help_zh:
弹性网卡的状态。取值范围：

Available：可用。
Attaching：附加中。
InUse：已附加。
Detaching：分离中。
Deleting：删除中。

默认值：空，表示查询所有状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use the MaxResults and NextToken parameters for pagination

parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use the MaxResults and NextToken parameters for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，建议您通过指定MaxResults或NextToken参数时使用分页方式查询

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Set this parameter to the `NextToken` value returned in the previous API call.

For information about how to view the returned data, refer to the operation description above
parameters.help_zh:
查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的`NextToken`参数值。

有关本接口查看返回数据的设置方式，请参见上文接口说明
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 10 to 500.

Default value:

If you do not set this parameter or set it to a value less than 10, the default value is 10.
If you set this parameter to a value greater than 500, the default value is 500
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围：10~500。

默认值：

当不设置值或设置的值小于10时，默认值为10。
当设置的值大于500时，默认值为500
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The secondary private IP address of the network interface controller (NIC). Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡的辅助私网IPv4地址。N的取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The network interface controller (NIC) ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en: The IPv6 address of the network interface controller (NIC). N indicates that you can specify multiple IPv6 addresses. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡的IPv6地址。N表示可以设置多个IPv6地址，N的取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: ipv6_address
